name: Lively
tagline: Best Buy Health's Jitterbug phones and Lively Mobile urgent-response devices
daily_ok_verdict: Lively (formerly GreatCall / Jitterbug, now Best Buy Health) is hardware-gated urgent response: a Jitterbug phone or Lively Mobile Plus device with an Urgent Response button connecting to live agents, plus optional Care Advocate and nurse services. Daily OK is the inverse — a proactive once-a-day check-in on the smartphone your parent already owns, with family-first alerts and no call center. If your parent needs a simplified phone and reactive emergency response, Lively's ecosystem is purpose-built. If they own a normal smartphone and you mainly want the daily reassurance that they're up and OK, Daily OK is far cheaper and adds the proactive layer Lively doesn't.

migration_guide: Decide whether a simplified phone or live urgent-response agents are must-haves. If yes, Lively serves a need Daily OK doesn't.
If your parent already uses a normal smartphone well, a dedicated device may be unnecessary overhead.
Install Daily OK on your own phone; invite your parent by SMS link (under two minutes).
Pick a morning check-in time tied to an existing routine.
Agree what a missed check-in means in advance.
If cancelling a Lively plan, review their current cancellation and device terms first.

faqs.q: Is Daily OK a replacement for Lively?
faqs.a: Not if your parent needs a simplified Jitterbug phone or live urgent-response agents. Daily OK is a daily check-in app for a parent who already uses a smartphone. They solve different problems and can coexist.
Lively bundles a device, urgent-response agents, and optional nurse/care services. Daily OK is software only with family-first alerts, so it starts at $3.99/month.
No. Daily OK has no location, camera, or microphone access. It only records whether the daily check-in was tapped.
Yes — keep Lively for urgent response and add Daily OK for the proactive daily confirmation Lively doesn't provide.
